Private wb As Object

Public Sub Setup()

Public Sub Reopen(ByVal folder As String)
    Dim path As String
    path = folder & Application.PathSeparator & "reads.xlsx"

    wb.Close False
    Set wb = Workbooks.Open(path)
End Sub

Public Sub Finish()

    v = TypeName(ws.Range("B2").Borders)
